Naomi Osaka may have exited the US Open, but she went out with a burst - of colour, and a bit of swag. Which outfit was your best of the tournament? metadata.summary: Warwickshire ramped up their bid for the Rothesay County Championship Division One title as they rolled Glamorgan for 69 all out in Cardiff.
metadata.content: Warwickshire turn up the heat on Somerset and Nottingham in County Championship as they inflict Glamorgan 19-year first | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Warwickshire turn up the heat on Somerset and Nottingham in County Championship as they inflict Glamorgan 19-year first The Rothesay County Championship title chase cranked up as Warwickshire dominated in Wales; Division Two Durham were put to the test by Middlesex before pulling off impressive comeback By Natasha Everitt Tuesday 8 September 2026 23:05, UK Image: Ethan Bamber was on fire for Warwickshire Warwickshire ramped up their bid for the Rothesay County Championship Division One title as they rolled Glamorgan for 69 all out in Cardiff. Just five points separate the Bears from leaders Somerset and Nottinghamshire heading into the last three fixtures, and Ethan Bamber took a scintillating 5-28 that took him past 50 wickets for the season. Ed Barnard backed him up with 3-5 against the tail as the first innings concluded inside just 27 overs.
